name: Transcriptions of Time
summary:
"Transcriptions of Time" is a visual novel RPG set in New York across three distinct eras (1926, 2026, and 2126), following the discovery of Time Travel where you will transition eras alongside your best friend, with your new device that starts unfolding into unforeseen consequences. The game features an arc of body transformations and slow burn MtF feminization that will expand in future Chapters.

The game blends many different genres: At its heart the story is a character driven cozy slice of life that focuses on the player character and their best friend Matt on their time travel adventures. Underneath all the subtext spins a mystery psychological thriller, that integrates all the mechanics of the players transformations from its foundation of Sci-fi and speculative historical fiction.

Built in Twine using Sugarcube, it heavily relies on Javascript and CSS, custom images for Passage Headers, fashion for the Paperdoll, audio for the in-game music player, and video animations for special sections.
